lines.en: I walk up to Ami’s door and knock on it.
It’s surprisingly nice outside tonight so I figure it might be a good chance to check out that maid cafe we talked about during our trip to the mall recently.
: One sec! Coming!
: I recognize that knock. Why is he here?
: Shh. He can hear you through the door, Maya!
: Oh, my mistake. I’ll ask him directly.
: What? N-
: Sensei, why are you here?
: Oh, Maya’s here too.
: I live here.
: Hey! What’s up? You’re here to see me, right?
: Did you need something?
: Maya and I were about to head over to the maid cafe if you want to tag along.
: Or you can not tag along. That works just as well.
: I was actually going to suggest going over there tonight. What a fortunate coincidence this is.
: Yes, how fortunate indeed.
: I’m practically jumping for joy.
: Sorry, Sensei. Maya has been in a bad mood all day for some reason.
: She’s probably just hungry. She gets like that sometimes when she hasn’t eaten for a while.
: I’m annoyed by how true that is. But yes, I require food immediately or I am probably going to kill someone.
: Not it. Take Ami instead.
: What?! Why are you willing to sacrifice me so easily?!
: Understood. She would be easier to kill anyway.
: As much as I hate to say it, you’re obnoxiously tall and I’d probably have trouble taking you down.
: Just make sure that you kill her at the cafe so you can have her body flavor beamed before the funeral.
: I don’t want to be flavor beamed! I just want a job!
: Well then we should probably be leaving, shouldn’t we?
: Unless you want to just pick something up for me. That works too.
: Hold the flavor beam, please. I don’t think it has any real effect.
: I’ll take Maya’s flavor beam.
: I’m annoyed that you even know what the flavor beam is.
: I knew you liked maids but I didn’t think you liked that part of them too.
: Am I going to have to flavor beam all of your food at home from now on?
: That won’t be necessary. I’ll just ask Uta-chan for her number and have her come over and do it.
: Over my dead body...
The three of us make our way out of the dorm shortly after Ami tells Maya she doesn’t want to be bothered carrying food all the way home.
I think it’s a little rude when I first hear it and even go as far as almost offering to carry it myself-
But then I remember exactly how much Maya is able to eat and decide against it considering that I’d likely need to rent a forklift in order to get all of it back to her.
Some time later...
: Huh...There’s no one here.
: That’s usually how it works. You should know this by now.
: Someone will show up soon enough.
: Maybe it would be better if we just came at a different time? Isn’t it kind of rude to apply somewhere in the middle of the night?
: Chickening out already? You haven’t even talked to anyone yet.
: Chicken sounds good. Thank you for the suggestion.
: I’m not being a chicken! I just feel really jittery all of a sudden. My legs feel all wobbly and my tummy is doing cartwheels.
: Is this what cancer is, Sensei? Do I have cancer?
: What? No.
: Why would you even assume that?
: Ahhhh I’m not even wearing a suit!
: You don’t even own a suit.
: Do they even have chicken here? They have to, right?
: Ahh! Customers!
: I’ll be right with you, masters! I’ve just...gotta...
: OH NO!
The sounds of glassware shattering in the kitchen echo throughout the room but neither Ami nor Maya react.
I guess this sort of thing happens often enough for them to just...shrug it off?
: Ah! Master! You’ve returned!
: What just happened in the-
: Nothing! Don’t mind that.
: Here I was thinkin’ you’d take the next trillion years finishing all of those cakes you bought from me last time you were here.
: There is no amount of cakes that can keep me away from you, Uta-chan.
: Uhh, ew.
: Excuse me? What did you just say to Uta-chan, Sensei?
: Awww, stop! You don’t mean that~
: Either way, I’m really happy you came back to see me, Master! Is there anything I can get for you tonight?
: You’ve gotta remember, though, I’m not on the menu~
: One of everything please.
: This is why you have no money to buy me things?! Because you spend all of it on Uta-chan?!
: Don’t mind her, Uta-chan. That’s just my [niece].
: Princess Ami is your [niece]? That’s so cool! You two look nothing alike!
: It's so cute that you two hang out together!
: If anything, I would have thought you were here with-
: Wait. Hold on a second.
I step closer to Uta and cover my mouth with the side of my hand so Ami can’t see what I’m saying.
I notice her clenching a fist out of the corner of my eye so I do my best to keep what I have to say short.
: Don’t say that I was here with Maya last time. Ami will get jealous.
: Ohohohoh...
: I see. I see.
: That’s really naughty, Master.
: A secret relationship with a girl that much smaller than you?
: Is that what you’re trying to get out of Uta-chan as well?
: That’s not exactly what was happening last time.
: Right, right. And I’m not exactly a maid~
: Your secret’s safe with me, Master. I won’t tell a soul as long as you promise to come see me again~
: I will literally live here if you let me.
: I’m trying really hard to not freak out on you two right now and you’re making it quite difficult.
: Oh. Right.
: Uta-chan, Ami had something she wanted to talk to you about.
: Princess Ami had something she wanted to talk to me about? I wonder what it could be?
: Oh, umm...Yeah.
: Uhhh. Hi.
: Hi~
: She wants a job.
: I was getting there!
: A job? Here? With me?
: OHMYGOD! That sounds so fun!
: Come talk to me on the couch for a little while.
: I’m not really able to hire you myself, but I can definitely put a good word in for you since I know you so well!
: I didn’t realize you two were on such good terms, Ami.
: Well...Like I said, Maya and I come here sometimes. And Uta-chan is pretty much always here, so.
: Princess! Couch! Now! Come!
: Ah! Yes! Sorry!
Uta pulls Ami to the side and begins asking her a ton of questions I can’t be bothered to follow along with.
I should have probably coached Ami on how to properly conduct herself in an interview beforehand but...eh.
She’s smart enough to figure it out and it’s not like wearing a dress and calling people “Master” is a particularly hard job.
She’ll be fine. I know she will.
: Are you sure about this?
: Sure about what? Ami getting a job?
: It was her idea.
: Well, kind of.
: I didn’t really expect her to follow through with it, but she’s free to do what she wants.
: Is there something wrong with that?
: It’s just not something that’s ever happened before.
: I doubt something this small would have any effect on the world itself, but it’s still weird.
: You’re not going to start talking about that butterfly effect thing, are you?
: I was going to, but I can just...not do that if you already know what it is.
: It’s that thing about how a butterfly flapping its wings could...you know. Tornadoes and stuff.
: Well that’s definitely one way to put it.
: I’m honestly more concerned about why you’re so open to this if you’re just going to-
: Wait...You’re not just doing this because you want to see her in the costume, are you?
: Not entirely...
: She’s your [niece]...
: Is she really, though?
: You’re disgusting.
: Yes I am, Maya. Yes I am.
Meanwhile...
: So, you really wanna work here?
: Like, really really REALLY really wanna work here?
: I kind of just...want some spending money. And to see Sensei more, if I’m being totally honest.
: You mean your [uncle]? You call him Sensei?
: That’s kinda weird.
: Well, he’s also my teacher. So it’s...less weird.
: Still weird, though.
: Yeah...I try not to think too much about it.
: Why do you think working here will help you see him more, though?
: I’m pretty sure he’s only shown up the one time.
: I mean, he did buy like, every single cake we had when he was here. But yeah.
: You’d probably see him more if you just stayed at home.
: Ah! Not saying I don’t think you should work here or anything!
: You’d fit right in with how cute you are. And besides, we don’t have anybody with twintails on the staff and that’s like, only one of the most fetishy hairstyles out there.
: Has Sensei really only come here once?
: When we talked earlier, he made it sound like he basically lived here.
: You sure that wasn’t just you jumping to conclusions?
: Besides, even if he was addicted to this place, it’s not like it would be weird or anything.
: Everybody loves maids. And he’s a boy so you can’t even hold that against him.
: Well...I guess that’s true.
: I don’t know. It’s just kind of strange thinking about how I wound up here in the first place.
: Like, just this morning, I was making breakfast for him and thinking of how nice it would be to just...keep doing that for the rest of eternity.
: Aww~ You really love him, don’t you?
: Of course. He’s the only family I have.
: I get that. I moved here two years ago and the rest of my family is still in Nara. It gets really lonely sometimes.
: Nara?! Isn’t that the place with all of the deer?!
: Yup! There was actually a whole family of deer that lived in our backyard.
: They were super cute until my big brother just shot them all one day.
: They were a lot less cute after that.
: Really tasty, though.
: What?...
: Where did he even get a gun?...
: Idunno. He’s in jail now so I can’t really ask. My parents might know, though.
: What did this conversation turn into?...
: Who knows?
: But anyway, I’ll put in a good word for ya.
: I’m not gonna make you fill out an application or any of that boring stuff.
: I’ll make sure you get hired, too, so we can take this friendship to the next level!
: You’ll have fun here. I know it.
: And just in case you’re having any doubts, I’ll even let you take one of my costumes home to try on!
: I swear you’ll be even more excited to work once you see yourself in it.
: That’s really nice of you, but...
: Do you have any costumes for girls that are still...growing?
: Hm?
: Oooooohhhh...I get it. You mean boobs.
: Yeah. I’ll look.
: Don’t worry, Ami. We’ll get through this together.
: Life is miserable...
Ami returns to the table Maya and I had taken a seat at several minutes later with a look of dejection spreading across her face.
I figure it’s due to not getting the job or something like that, but I'm quickly informed that she’ll be starting soon and that the look is due to something else.
It’s actually kind of similar to the look Maya’s had ever since she realized she was going to need to wait before ordering her food.
Either way, I’m glad things ended up well for Ami.
I just hope I can see her in the outfit soon.
Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
